rules.question: At what moment does the Path Builder put a fill, on its timeline and for the Preview's clock?
rules.owner: timeline_fill_ms in src/ui/preview_timeline.cpp, the end of the fill's span, which the Fills row, a list row's scroll to its fill, and every move of the Preview's clock to a fill (a fill or row click) all read
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-31-path-builder-redesign-3.md (removed; git show 307d0b5c:docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-31-path-builder-redesign-3.md), SC-4b, a list row whose fill is off screen scrolls the timeline to it (bar question 5); and D303 item 9, one position per fill: the clock line sits exactly on the fill's dot

owner_lines.line_text: double timeline_fill_ms(const app::PreviewFill& fill) { return fill.span.end_ms; }
owner_lines.why: timeline_fill_ms: the one place the Path Builder reads where a fill sits

rules.note: Where the Path Builder puts a fill is the end of its span: the timeline's dot, and the Preview's clock when a click moves it to a fill, so the clock line sits on the dot. Reading either end of a fill's span by hand in the builder or the timeline places the fill a second time; the span's start once put the clock at a different moment from the dot. pb_text.cpp reads the end of a span to count saved Star Power bars, a different question, so it is out of scope. A scope names a top folder or a single file (OwnerRule::scope), so the row lists each file under src/pathbuilder but pb_text.cpp; a new file there joins the list.
